svg.aria-label: Core2350B to Tang Nano20K: 16-signal point-to-point wiring reservation
svg.title: Core2350B to Tang Nano20K: 16-signal point-to-point wiring reservation
svg.text: Core2350B: RP2350B / 8 MB PSRAM / 16 MB flash • Tang Nano20K hardware 3921
Wiring reservation; physical bus wrapper/driver not implemented
Power boards through their normal inputs.
Join common GND: Tang J6.20, J5.2, J5.15
to Core P1.1 / P3.1 (fan-out as needed).
Tang J6.19: local pull-up rail only.
WREADY and RVALID. No data pull resistors.
GPU_RESET_N low holds the GPU in reset.
ABORT is active high; *_N is active low.
Pulls attach on the Tang pin side of series R.
33Ω at each driving end; data: 33Ω each end
Disconnect the Tang FPC LCD and VGA DAC.
Future RP drive ≥8mA per net (12mA advised).
Keep ALL 16 signal links OPEN until compatible Core firmware + FPGA image are installed.
Assembly while unpowered is OK; keep removable links open on powered old images. 33Ω does not make contention safe.
Core connector numbers are P1/P3 schematic positions, not RP2350 package pins or Pico 2 numbering.
Sources: Core2350B manufacturer schematic; Tang Nano20K Rev 1.30 / hardware 3921 (2023-07-11). Exact evidence: pinout JSON.
